title: Towards a generalized Maeda conjecture for modular forms with quadratic nebentypus
summary: We establish a lower bound for the number of non-CM Galois orbits of newforms in $S_k(N,Ψ)$ with non-trivial quadratic nebentypus $Ψ$ for sufficiently large weights. Extending the work of Dieulefait, Pacetti, and Tsaknias in the trivial nebentypus setting, we analyze the restrictions imposed by the quadratic character on local inertial types and determine the number of admissible Galois orbits of such types.
